create_singleton_class: create a class that inherits from Singleton metaclass to ensure only one instance exists
get_singleton_instance: get the singleton instance of a class by calling the instance method on the class
get_singleton_state: get a deep copy of all singleton instances and omegaconf resolvers for serialization
set_singleton_state: restore singleton instances and omegaconf resolvers from a previously saved state dictionary
review_singleton_metaclass: review the Singleton metaclass __call__ method to understand how instance caching works
